model.reasoning: Transcription of the supervisor's gate-cleared fair value build ($85.0), not a re-decision. Legs: P/E 18.75x (its 18.5-19x) on $4.60 NTM EPS at Sep-2027 (its $4.55-4.65) = $86.25, weight 0.5; equity FCF yield 5.0% on $4.26 (FY28 FCF $2.45B / 575M) = $85.2, weight 0.3 (the low end of its $85.2-87.0 range, as in its verified $85.2 blend); EV/EBITDA 16x on ~$3.2B NTM EBITDA less $3.8B Sep-2027 net debt over 575M shares, weight 0.2 (its settled disagreement: the agents' 14-15.5x double-counts the derating already in an 18.5-19x P/E). Engine base horizon value 85.32 vs $85.0; median 85.40. Multiple caveat from the citation gate: on NTM EPS the NXPI-ON range is about 13.7-18.5x (ON ~18.5x, NXPI ~13.7x; TXN ~27.6x and ADI ~24.6x above), so the supervisor's 18.5-19x sits at the top of the NXPI-ON range rather than in its middle as the original current-year comparison (NXPI ~15x, ON ~24x) suggested. The multiple is transcribed as chosen; at 13.7-18.5x the P/E leg would be ~$63-85, which is the main downside sensitivity of this set. Drivers the supervisor did not settle use the five forecasters' medians: FY28 revenue $7.4B, non-GAAP operating margin 40%, depreciation 2.74% of revenue, capex 1.69%, FY29 growth 0.0419, interest ~$180M, and the scenario probabilities (20/55/25) and deltas (bear EPS -24.4% and -3.5 turns, bull +17.0% and +3.5 turns). Filled in (not in any original work): FY2026 base revenue (F3), FY2027 revenue and margin from Q1 actuals and the Q2 guide, SBC 5.42% of revenue (F46/F6), working capital from agent 3's ~$150M, zero terminal growth, the 5.0% FCF yield reused as the DCF capitalisation rate (DCF weight 0, not a cost-of-capital view) and scenario_vol fitted to the supervisor's ladder. Reference figures are only those the run cites (8-K Ex. 99.1 guidance, Citi TMT, StockAnalysis/S&P Global consensus as of 2026-09-18).
